label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Anyone who loves us Ahlul Bayt must be ready to face a life of austerity.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: A friend cannot be considered a friend unless he is tested on three occasions: in time of need, behind your back and after your death.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: There is enough light for one who wants to see.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: It is wiser to abstain than to repent.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Obstinacy will prevent you from a correct decision.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: If two opposite theories are propagated one will be wrong.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: When truth was revealed to me I never doubted it.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Death is never very far.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: One who forsakes truth earns eternal damnation.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: O son of Adam, if you have collected anything in excess of your actual need, you will act only as its trustee for someone else to use it.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: There are people who worship Allah to gain His Favors, this is the worship of traders; while there are some who worship Him to keep themselves free from His Wrath, this is the worship of slaves; a few who obey Him out' of their sense of gratitude and obligations, this is the worship of free and noble men.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Where are those who protect honour, and those self-respecting persons who defend respectable persons in the time of hardship? Shame is behind you while Paradise is in front of you.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: During civil disturbance adopt such an attitude that people do not attach any importance to you — they neither burden you with complicated affairs, nor try to derive any advantage out of you.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: When Imam Ali was asked about Faith in Religion, he replied that the structure of faith is supported by four pillars endurance, conviction, justice and jihad.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: To refrain from unlawful and impious source of pleasures is an ornament to the poor and to be thankful for the riches granted is the adornment of wealth.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: If you cannot get things as much as you desire than be contented with what you have.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: An ignorant person will always overdo a thing or neglect it totally.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Time wears out bodies, renews hopes, brings death nearer and takes away aspirations. Whoever gets anything from the world lives in anxiety for holding it and whoever loses anything passes his days grieving over the loss.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Whoever wants to be a leader should educate himself before educating others. Before preaching to others he should first practice himself. Whoever educates himself and improves his own morals is superior to the man who tries to teach and train others.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Anything which can be counted is finite and will come to an end.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: If matters get mixed up then scrutinize the cause and you will know what the effects will be.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: A man sarcastically started praising Imam Ali, though he had no faith in him and Imam Ali hearing these praises from him said "I am less than what you tell about me but more than what you think about me.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Those who have come alive out of a blood-bath live longer and have more children.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: One who imagines himself to be all-knowing will surely suffer on account of his ignorance.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: I appreciate an old man's cautious opinion more than the valor of a young man.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Nawf bin Fizala Bakali, the famous scholar of the early Islamic days says that one night he was with Imam Ali. In the middle of the night, Imam Ali got up from his bed, looked for sometime at the stars and inquired of Nawf whether he was awake. Nawf said: "I got from my bed replying, "Yes, Amirul Mo'minin (Commander of the Faithful) ! I am awake".
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Imam Ali said Nawf! Those are the fortunate people who adopt piety as the principle of their lives and are fully attentive to their welfare for the Hereafter. They accept bare earth as the most comfortable bed and water as the most pleasant drink. They adopt the Holy Qur'an and prayers as their guide and protector and like Prophet Jesus Christ (Isa) they forsake the world and its vicious pleasure.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Nawf! Prophet David (Daud) once got up at such an hour in the night and said this was the hour when prayers of everyone who prayed were accepted except of those who forcibly collected revenues or who were scandal- mongers or were persons in the police force of a despotic regime or were musicians".
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: If you understand Allah's Majesty, then you will not attach any importance to the creatures.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: If you want to pray to Allah for better means of subsistence, then first give something in charity
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: When someone is sure of the returns, then he shows generosity.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Aid (from Allah) is in proportion to the trouble.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: He who practices moderation and frugality will never be threatened with poverty.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: One of the conveniences in life is to have less children.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Grief is half of old age.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Grant of patience (from Allah) is in proportion to the extent of calamity you are passing through. If you exhibit fretfulness, irritation, and despair in calamities, then your patience and your exertions are wasted.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Many persons get nothing out of their fasts but hunger and thirst, many more get nothing out of their night prayers but exertions and sleepless nights. Wise and sagacious persons are praiseworthy even if they do not fast and sleep during the nights.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Defend your faith (in Allah) with the help of charity. Protect your wealth with the aid of Zakat. Let the prayers guard you from calamities and disasters.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: The first fruit of forbearance is that people will sympathize with you and they will go against the man who offended you arrogantly.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: One who takes account of his shortcomings will always gain by it; one who is unmindful of them will always suffer. One who is afraid of the Day of Judgment, is safe from the Wrath of Allah. One who takes lessons from the events of life, gets vision, one who acquires vision becomes wise and one who attains wisdom achieves knowledge.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: One who comes into power often oppresses.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Adversities often bring good qualities to the front.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: If a friend envies you, then he is not a true friend.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Avarice dulls the faculties of judgment and wisdom.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Oppression and tyranny are the worse companions for the Hereafter.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Silence will create respect and dignity; justice and fairplay will bring more friends; benevolence and charity will enhance prestige and position; courtesy will draw benevolence; service of mankind will secure leadership and good words will overcome powerful enemies.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: A greedy man will always find himself in the shackles of humility.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: These are the orders issued by the creature of Allah, Ali, the son Abu Taalib to Maalik, the son of Ashtar when he appointed Maalik as the Governor of Egypt to collect zakat there, to combat the enemies of Islam and Egypt, to work for the welfare of its people and to look after its prosperity.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Do not feel ashamed to forgive and forget.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Do not hurry over punishments and do not be pleased and do not be proud of your power to punish.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Do not get angry and lose your temper quickly over the mistakes and failures of those over whom you rule. On the contrary, be patient and sympathetic with them.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Never say to yourself, "I am their Lord, their ruler and all in all over them and that I must be obeyed submissively and humbly" because such a thought will unbalance your mind, will make you vain and arrogant, will weaken your faith in religion and will make you seek support of any power other than that of Allah.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Being ungrateful for a blessing causes it to be taken away.
author: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)
label: Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A)

text: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq said to Khalid ibn al-Walid: 'Strive for death, then you will be given life.'"واحرص على الموت توهب لك الحياة" Al-ʿIqd al-Farīd author Ibn Abd Rabbih (1/92 )
author: Abu Bakr (R.A)
label: Abu Bakr (R.A)

text: I know that you are just a stone and that you can neither do any harm nor give benefit. Had I not seen Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allâh be upon him) kissing you, I would not have kissed you.
author: Umar ibn Al-Khattāb (R.A)
label: Umar ibn Al-Khattāb (R.A)
